newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended firmer on Tuesday, lifted by private investors' short-covering, particularly in nearby months, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 2.5 yen per kg higher. The benchmark March contract was unchanged at 133.0 yen.
Activity was lacklustre amid a dearth of fresh incentives.
The market had started the day on a firmer note.

"Short-covering in nearby months caused today's gains after most contracts hit life-of-contract lows on Monday. But private investors remained wary of fresh buying," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
